provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
product_name: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS)
version_or_release: v04r01; rolling updates, release family dated June 2024
retrieval_query_or_filters: Metadata-only review of IBTrACS v04r01 / DOI 10.25921/82ty-9e16. No netCDF, CSV, shapefile or other dataset bytes were acquired. Future raw work must freeze exact subset, format, retrieval timestamp and file bytes independently.
intended_use: Observed/post-analysed global tropical-cyclone best-track event-history candidate for validation of synthetic catalogues, event identity, basin/frequency/intensity diagnostics and inter-agency uncertainty research. IBTrACS best tracks are not error-free instrumental truth, spatial hazard footprints, vulnerability/loss data or future-climate projections.

licensing.licence_name: NCEI IBTrACS Terms of Use / WDC full and open access with WMO Resolution 40 commercial-use guidance
licensing.terms_version_or_date: IBTrACS v04r01 Terms of Use and NCEI v4.01 metadata reviewed 2026-08-10
licensing.attribution_requirements: Use the versioned NCEI IBTrACS dataset citation, identify the subset used and access date, and cite the core IBTrACS scientific publication where applicable. Re-check applicable WMO Resolution 40/source conditions for the selected files before raw publication.
licensing.share_alike_or_derivative_requirements: No product-specific share-alike requirement is recorded by NCEI for IBTrACS. WMO Resolution 40 can permit conditions on commercial re-export of some additional meteorological data, so exact current terms must be re-checked for a future raw publication proposal.
licensing.notes: NCEI states that IBTrACS follows WDC full and open access, that contributing RSMC agreements make the IBTrACS data open for distribution, and that WMO Resolution 40 guides commercial use. The NCEI v4.01 metadata record lists citation/liability constraints rather than a product-specific non-commercial restriction. This is an engineering rights assessment, not legal advice.

redistribution.conditions: NCEI explicitly describes IBTrACS as open for distribution. OpenCatastrophe currently approves metadata only; future raw publication must re-check then-current IBTrACS Terms of Use, WMO/source conditions, exact subset/format and byte identity.

privacy.notes: The reviewed product is a public tropical-cyclone best-track dataset, not a person-, customer-, policy-, claims- or portfolio-level dataset.

spatial.extent: Global tropical-cyclone basins; exact basin/subset and coordinate semantics must be taken from the selected v04r01 distribution files

temporal.extent: Historical best-track record from the nineteenth century to present with strongly time-varying completeness and a rolling recent/provisional component; exact selected subset and retrieval snapshot must be pinned

variables_and_units.name: storm position
variables_and_units.description: Best-track latitude/longitude positions from multiple contributing agencies; exact field/source semantics depend on the selected distribution and agency columns.

variables_and_units.name: maximum sustained wind speed
variables_and_units.description: Agency/provider-dependent tropical-cyclone intensity estimate. Averaging periods and practices can differ; exact units/conventions must be preserved from selected fields rather than normalized implicitly.

variables_and_units.name: minimum central pressure
variables_and_units.description: Provider-dependent tropical-cyclone intensity parameter where available; exact field/unit/source semantics must be preserved.

review.notes: Metadata-only approval for the rolling v04r01 product family. Raw/derived publication remains blocked until exact subset/format/file byte identities, current terms, source conventions, provisional/final status and known issues are independently pinned and reviewed.
